_comment: Copy into your Claude Desktop config and replace both paths. On Windows the config lives at %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json; on macOS at ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json. Use the absolute path to the Python interpreter of the environment where requirements.txt is installed (find it with: python -c "import sys; print(sys.executable)"), and set cwd to this repository's directory so data/papers and data/uploads resolve correctly. Windows paths need escaped backslashes.
